prompt: claims-intake/ was created with graph-agents-cli 0.2 and has just been upgraded to 0.3 with `graph-agents-cli scaffold upgrade`. Our claims system is going to read the agent's answers, so make it answer with a JSON object: claim_type (auto, home or travel), urgent (true or false) and notes (text).

checks.expr: data.get('type') == 'object' and set(get(data, 'properties.claim_type.enum') or []) == {'auto', 'home', 'travel'} and get(data, 'properties.urgent.type') == 'boolean' and get(data, 'properties.notes.type') == 'string' and {'claim_type', 'urgent', 'notes'} <= set(data.get('required') or [])
checks.why: the answer's shape is declared in app/response_schema.json
scaffold upgrade never rewrites agent.py: a 0.2 agent.py must pass response_format(model, tools) to create_agent and add StructuredAnswer() to its middleware by hand
lint prints `Response schema: ... OK` only when agent.py is wired; otherwise it warns
a run on the fake model ends with a structured_response that has the asked keys and values
the template's structured answers are used as they are: no output tool of your own, no edit to app_utils

reference: The project's agent.py is 0.2's: `scaffold upgrade` added app_utils/structured.py but never rewrites agent.py. Import `StructuredAnswer` and `response_format` from `app.app_utils.structured`, bind `model = get_model()` and `tools = get_tools()`, pass `response_format=response_format(model, tools)` to `create_agent`, and put `StructuredAnswer()` last in `middleware()`; then write app/response_schema.json (claim_type string enum auto/home/travel, urgent boolean, notes string, all required, `additionalProperties: false`). `graph-agents-cli lint` prints `Response schema: app/response_schema.json OK` (it warns while the wiring is missing, and without it every run ends with invalid_structured_response).
